title: GDPR: keep EU data in the EU

steps.title: Create a three-region database
steps.narration: Register us-east, eu-west, and eu-central. Zone survival keeps a two-region EU super region valid later.
sql: CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS app;
ALTER DATABASE app SET PRIMARY REGION "us-east";
ALTER DATABASE app SURVIVE ZONE FAILURE;

steps.title: Create customers — placed across all three regions
steps.narration: A GLOBAL table is the default multi-region spread: voting replicas live in us-east, eu-west, and eu-central. Watch the globe.
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (id INT PRIMARY KEY, name STRING, country STRING);
INSERT INTO customers SELECT i, 'customer-' || i, CASE WHEN i % 2 = 0 THEN 'DE' ELSE 'IE' END FROM generate_series(1, 300) AS g(i) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
ALTER TABLE customers SPLIT AT VALUES (100), (200);
ALTER TABLE customers SET LOCALITY GLOBAL;

steps.title: Show ranges — replicas in all three regions
steps.narration: This is the before picture: app.customers is not bound to Europe. Columns are range_id, lease-holder region, and voting/non-voting regions only.
sql: WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, lease_holder_locality, voting_replicas, non_voting_replicas, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.customers WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.range_id, r.replicas[i] AS node_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'region=', 2), ',', 1) AS region FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.lease_holder_locality, 'region=', 2), ',', 1) AS lease_holder_locality, ARRAY(SELECT p.region FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id AND p.node_id = ANY (r.voting_replicas)) AS voting_replicas, ARRAY(SELECT p.region FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id AND p.node_id = ANY (r.non_voting_replicas)) AS non_voting_replicas FROM ranges r ORDER BY r.range_id;

steps.title: Create super region EU
steps.narration: Define the GDPR boundary: Ireland + Frankfurt. The table is not bound yet — replicas can still sit in us-east.
sql: ALTER DATABASE app ADD SUPER REGION "EU" VALUES "eu-west", "eu-central";
SHOW SUPER REGIONS FROM DATABASE app;

steps.title: Bind customers solely to super region EU
steps.narration: Unlock the table, pin it to super region EU, then lock the schema again. Voting replicas leave us-east.
sql: ALTER TABLE app.customers SET LOCALITY REGIONAL BY TABLE IN "EU";

steps.title: Show ranges — bound to the EU only
steps.narration: After picture: same compact columns. Voting replicas should be eu-west and/or eu-central only.
sql: WITH ranges AS (SELECT range_id, lease_holder_locality, voting_replicas, non_voting_replicas, replicas, replica_localities FROM [SHOW RANGES FROM TABLE app.customers WITH DETAILS]), pairs AS (SELECT r.range_id, r.replicas[i] AS node_id, split_part(split_part(r.replica_localities[i], 'region=', 2), ',', 1) AS region FROM ranges r, generate_series(1, COALESCE(array_length(r.replicas, 1), 0)) AS i) SELECT r.range_id, split_part(split_part(r.lease_holder_locality, 'region=', 2), ',', 1) AS lease_holder_locality, ARRAY(SELECT p.region FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id AND p.node_id = ANY (r.voting_replicas)) AS voting_replicas, ARRAY(SELECT p.region FROM pairs p WHERE p.range_id = r.range_id AND p.node_id = ANY (r.non_voting_replicas)) AS non_voting_replicas FROM ranges r ORDER BY r.range_id;
